The *Saṅgahavāra* ("The classes of offenses to which each rule belongs") is a section of the *Parivāra*, the closing analytical compendium of the Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Functioning as a technical monastic analysis, the text defines which rules and offenses fall under the heading or classification of other rules [SuttaCentral]. Modern translations include an English translation by Bhikkhu Brahmali listed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
